scope: Independent read-only source/API-fixture review; not proof of actual native navigation or actual scenario completion. Parent owns hot deployment and finite live acceptance.

independentTests.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/people -p test_native_plan.py -q

reviewedContracts.selectionArea: Exact existing East south pad x[-12.2,-10.2],y[69.2,72] and north pad x[-12.2,-10.2],y[86.4,90.4]. No camera/ROI/gap/signal edits.
reviewedContracts.targetPreference: Nominal first; then finite inward1m, outward1m/1.3m; lateral0/±.35, all independently subject to actualradius+.35 body/arrival inset, road exclusion and native path proof.
reviewedContracts.nativeProofBudget: At most12 actual proof calls across a selection, at most3 per character/direction; diagonal endpoint-pair ordering covers alternate entries as well as exits. Failed nearest actor does not consume the entire search.
reviewedContracts.nativePath: Actual native agent radius/height feed navmesh query; whole approach must avoid road/crossings; both final curb endpoints outside roadway and all painted crossings; full crossing path uses only the named strip. No tasks or actor/signal changes in preflight.
reviewedContracts.planning: Max(waypoint length, actual verified native crossingPathMetres), then unchanged speed/margins; current signal/native admission rechecks remain authoritative.
reviewedContracts.identity: Existing model/controller/people generation and epoch guards remain. Selected endpoints are locked as tuple-of-tuples; original template points/pads/radius pinned. Out-of-set and another allowed-candidate mutation both reject stale proof.
reviewedContracts.raceBoundary: All current other native actor positions/radii checked before selection and again for both locked points before continue. A newly blocked point causes pending, not retargeting or forced movement.
reviewedContracts.idempotency: Existing accepted command receipt and native owned-phase lease semantics retained; first choice is locked, no target search during a leased wait.
reviewedContracts.completion: Existing real .35m endpoint arrival, named-crossing whole-body exit and original native program restoration remain required. Simulator actions never substitute for camera evidence.

issuesAddressedBeforeFreeze: Native-invalid nominal point no longer hides all nearby alternatives.
Proof attempts are globally/per-direction bounded and distributed across actor choices.
Both far and near curb endpoints reject roadway envelope overlap.
Measured native path length cannot be replaced by a shorter waypoint estimate in planning.
Pad/body mutation and mutation to another otherwise-allowed endpoint cannot reuse the original proof.

savedBlockerPrediction.basis: Separate simulator preparation evidence only, not supplied to camera analytics
savedBlockerPrediction.interpretation: Inward alternate ends before the parked body; outward89.4 would require passing it. These geometric predictions still need actual native path/arrival acceptance.

limits: Static native path validity and current free endpoints do not reserve future dynamic space.
Twelve proof attempts are bounded preparation, not exhaustive path search or a runtime latency guarantee.
Original normal walker programs and their later interactions are not changed by this selector.
A later blocked/missing endpoint still causes finite failure/recovery; no arrival or analytic completion is fabricated.
